categories.label: Company Overview
categories.content: Meridian Atlas Group (Meridian Atlas Group Ltd) is a technology and management consulting firm headquartered in London with offices across EMEA and APAC. Company no. MAG-UK-884421. VAT GB884421001.

categories.label: Operating Model
categories.content: Practice-led delivery across Cloud, Security, and Consulting with shared PMO, Finance, and Customer Success functions. Demo workspace content only.

categories.label: Governance
categories.content: Board meets quarterly. Audit and Remuneration committees active. Cap table held under Atlas Founders Trust and Meridian Growth Partners.
